d:
In this episode of Inside the CIA: Secrets & Spies from National Geographic, Jose Rodriguez, a newly assigned director for counterterrorism, spearheads the CIA’s enhanced interrogation program to find those behind the Sept. 11 attacks and must contend with the consequences after the top-secret program is exposed to the American public.
